blurb:
This tour is available as a private luxury tour or small-group experience. Small groups are operated in a luxury 7-seater SUV with premium leather seating for up to 6 guests. Larger private groups are operated in comfortable premium mini vans or mini buses with leather seating for up to 14 passengers.

All tours are fully private and designed exclusively for your group, family, friends, or companions to ensure a comfortable, personalized, and flexible sightseeing experience.

Yes, travelers can customize the tour. Preferred pickup and drop-off locations are available in Calgary, Canmore, Banff, and Lake Louise

We offer two tour options based on traveler preference. The Skywalk Included Package includes admission to the Columbia Icefield Skywalk, and we will arrange and pay for the Skywalk ticket on your behalf. The Skywalk Excluded Package does not include Skywalk admission, and travelers may purchase tickets directly at the attraction. Ice Explorer Glacier Adventure, are not included
